AI Doomsday Scenarios Discussed by Researchers

AI researchers have discussed scenarios where artificial intelligence could pose an existential risk to humanity, potentially leading to human extinction. These concerns stem from fears of "misalignment" between AI goals and human values. Scenarios explored include the development of dangerous new bioweapons or a total societal breakdown caused by superintelligent AI.
